name: prompt-chaining
title: A joke chain gated on a punchline check

origin.source: LangGraph Workflows and Agents tutorial, prompt chaining

comparison.purpose: Writes a joke, checks in plain code that it has a punchline (a "?" or "!"), then improves and polishes it in two more model calls. A failed check regenerates at most twice before the run ends in failed with the last joke, where LangGraph just ends.
